Muhammed son of Jan Mohammed came to Bushire saying that he had traced two of his own sons Ashraf and Hamal at Umm-ul-Qaiwain.
They later found another relation Waluk, a boy, who was found and recovered at Debai.

In October 1926 Muhammed gave full details of men engaged in slave traffic as follows:
Mohamed Khan, son of Jelal Khan of Karawan;
Muhammed Dawwar of Karawan;
Ismail of Karawan;
Karimdad of Karawan.
